_instructions: Replace the entries in 'trends' with the curated seed trends. Load with: python scripts/seed_trends.py. Entries with "_placeholder": true are skipped. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Every trend needs at least one source. Set lifespan_weeks_est only when lifespan_source_url is one of the trend's source urls; otherwise leave it null and put the evidence in lifespan_label. features and category work best with values from backend/config/attributes.json (cut, color_family, fabric, category). first_seen is an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null. example_images are image URLs or data URLs. alternatives[].url only when a source gave that link.

_template.name: string, unique (case-insensitive)
_template.category: tee | shirt | sweater | hoodie | jacket | coat | jeans | pants | shorts | skirt | dress | shoes | bag | accessory
_template.lifespan_source_url: url from sources when lifespan_weeks_est is a number, else null

alternatives.url: null or a url from sources

trends.name: EXAMPLE barrel-leg jeans
trends.lifespan_label: About 20 weeks at peak, per the example source

alternatives.why_it_lasts: A straight leg has stayed in rotation for decades and pairs with most tops
alternatives.where_to_look: The core denim section of most stores
